common.tagline: Pastoral homeworld of the Cereans — low-tech by choice.
hyperlanes: Cerean spur off the Hydian Way
common.famousFor: Cereans, Jedi sympathies in the Clone Wars, and a culture that politely refuses most off-world tech.
common.cantinaReputation: Lush, mountainous world home to the Cereans. In 15 BBY, Cerea maintains strict isolationist policies — no offworld technology permitted in most settlements. The few spaceports cater to desperate travelers. Good place to disappear, terrible place to find spare parts.
